_readme: Hand-written corrections for the only two fields nobody publishes: cost and rateLimited.
The pipeline infers both from the README's scope markers and description text, which is weak
by design -- see scripts/lib/classify.ts. Anything corrected here wins over the inference and
is shown in the UI as a fact rather than a guess.
Keys under 'servers' are lowercase owner/repo. Fields:
note        free text, for readers of this file only

forgemeshlabs/coinopai-mcp.note: Charges per call via x402 USDC micropayments and needs a funded wallet key, so it is not free. The inference cannot see this: 'micropayments'/'USDC' are domain words that classify.ts deliberately ignores, since 92 entries mention USD because they are fintech servers, not because they cost money.
